newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT CANTERBURY 29-28 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT CANTERBURY 29-28 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.

text.p: Auckland Blues beat fellow New Zealanders Canterbury Crusaders 29-28 (halftime 20-13) in their Super 12 rugby union match on Friday.
Auckland - Tries: Joeli Vidiri, Robin Brooke. Conversions: Adrian Cashmore (2). Penalties: Cashmore (5).
Canterbury - Tries: Kevin Nepia, Daryl Lilley, Daryl Gibson. Conversions: Andrew Mehrtens (2). Penalties: Mehrtens (3).
